# prism_org_policy (Data Source)

Fetches information about an AWS Organizations policy through CloudKeeper Prism.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a single org policy by ID
data "prism_org_policy" "example" {
  management_account_id = "123456789012"
  id                    = "p-examplepolicyid"
}

output "policy_name" {
  value = data.prism_org_policy.example.name
}

output "policy_content" {
  value = data.prism_org_policy.example.content
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the policy
- `management_account_id` (String) The AWS management (payer) account ID that owns the organization

### Read-Only

- `aws_managed` (Boolean) Whether the policy is an AWS-managed policy
- `content` (String) The policy content as a JSON string
- `description` (String) A description of the policy
- `name` (String) The friendly name of the policy
- `policy_type` (String) The type of policy
